description: This file defines an interface (abstract class) IAudioCodec for Bluetooth A2DP audio codecs, including method signatures for configuration, encoding, decoding, and serialization, as well as related data structures and enums.

classes.name: IAudioCodec
classes.description: An interface for Bluetooth A2DP audio codecs, providing methods for configuration, encoding, decoding, and serialization.

methods.name: BitRate
methods.description: Returns the bitrate in bits per second.

methods.name: RawFrameSize
methods.description: Returns the size of raw frames.

methods.name: EncodedFrameSize
methods.description: Returns the size of encoded frames.

methods.name: QOS
methods.description: Returns the Quality of Service parameter based on a policy.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the codec with specified format and settings.

methods.name: Configuration
methods.description: Retrieves the current configuration of the codec.

methods.name: Encode
methods.description: Encodes raw data into compressed format.

methods.name: Decode
methods.description: Decodes compressed data into raw format.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the codec capabilities or configuration.
